title: Using BST order — LCA and range queries
summary: In a BST, the LCA of p and q is the first node whose value lies between them. Range sums and trims prune entire subtrees by comparing with the bounds.

sections.title: LCA in a BST
Range pruning
sections.body:
✍️ Range sum of BST (LeetCode 938): if node < low, only the right subtree can contain values in range; if node > high, only the left. Skip the other side entirely.
- Trim a BST, count nodes in range, closest value: same pruning by comparison.
